facts.text: The casitas and suites sit at the base of Boynton Canyon.
facts.excerpt: Nestled at the base of Boynton Canyon reside 218 casita guestrooms and suites.

facts.text: All rooms have a private deck or patio overlooking the canyon.
facts.excerpt: All rooms feature a private deck or patio overlooking the grandeur of the canyon.

facts.text: Each casita is designed in a Southwestern motif inspired by Sedona's landscapes.
facts.excerpt: Designed in a Southwestern motif, each casita draws inspiration from Sedona’s iconic landscapes.

facts.text: Rooms have fireplaces, elegant furnishings and Southwestern appointments.
facts.excerpt: Cozy fireplaces, elegant furnishings and authentic Southwestern appointments add the perfect ambiance to your stay.

facts.text: Each Pool Suite has a private pool, a viewing deck and an outdoor patio.
facts.excerpt: Each suite features spectacular views, a private pool, viewing deck and outdoor patio.

facts.text: One-bedroom suites have a living room with wood-beamed ceilings and a beehive fireplace.
facts.excerpt: The spacious living room welcomes guests with wood beamed ceilings, sophisticated textiles, a pull-down queen bed and a beehive fireplace for a warm ambiance.

facts.text: Trail House is the hub for outdoor adventures, with guided tours, professional-grade equipment rentals and a retail shop.
facts.excerpt: Trail House serves as an epicenter for all outdoor adventures, offering guided tours, professional-grade equipment rentals, and a retail shop featuring premium accessories and outdoor adventure apparel.

facts.text: Guests have access to over 400 miles of trails, and Trail House helps them choose hikes.
facts.excerpt: With access to over 400 miles of scenic trails, a visit to Trail House will help you choose which hiking trails are right for you.

facts.text: Complimentary stargazing with the resort astronomer is offered every Tuesday and Saturday evening, weather permitting.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary stargazing is offered at Enchantment Circle every Tuesday and Saturday evenings with our resort astronomer.

facts.text: Private Grand Canyon tours with Trail House guides include breakfast and a guided tour along the South Rim.
facts.excerpt: each Grand Canyon adventure includes breakfast and private guided tour along the South Rim.

facts.text: Premium mountain bikes and e-bikes can be rented during daylight hours.
facts.excerpt: A fleet of premium mountain bikes and e-bikes are available to rent during daylight hours.

facts.text: A complimentary Trail House session covers Boynton Canyon's history, geology, flora and fauna.
facts.excerpt: This complimentary session offers guests an opportunity for a richer understanding of its geology, flora and fauna

facts.text: Guests have exclusive access to spa services at the sister property Mii amo, located steps from the resort.
facts.excerpt: Located steps from Enchantment Resort, guests have exclusive access to spa services at our sister property, Mii amo.

facts.text: Enchantment guests may attend the twice-daily Mii amo Crystal Grotto rituals.
facts.excerpt: are invited to attend the twice-daily Mii amo Crystal Grotto rituals

facts.text: Mii amo access for Enchantment guests is for ages 16 and up.
facts.excerpt: As an Enchantment guest (ages 16+) you will be among the few to enjoy exclusive access to Mii amo.

facts.text: The resort is surrounded by acres of wilderness.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded on all sides by acres of pristine wilderness,

facts.text: The Edge is an open-air casual restaurant in the corner of the pool deck.
facts.excerpt: Nestled into the corner of the pool deck, discover The Edge, our newest open-air casual dining experience.

facts.text: Che Ah Chi closes on October 19, 2026, as the resort begins a transformation of its dining experiences.
facts.excerpt: Che Ah Chi will close on October 19, 2026, as we begin an exciting transformation of the resort dining experiences.

facts.text: New dining concepts are planned for 2027.
facts.excerpt: In 2027, we look forward to introducing new dining concepts that honor this extraordinary setting

facts.text: The resort is on the ancestral land of the Yavapai Tribe, in the Boynton Canyon vortex.
facts.excerpt: Located on the ancestral land of the Yavapai Tribe and in the Boynton Canyon vortex

facts.text: The resort opened in 1987, and Trail House was added in 2018.
facts.excerpt: The resort originally opened in 1987; in 2018, the Trail House was added to the property.

facts.text: The casitas are set in adobe, pueblo-style buildings.
facts.excerpt: The resort houses 218 casita guest rooms, which are set in adobe, pueblo-style buildings.

facts.text: Enchantment welcomes families with children of all ages.
facts.excerpt: Enchantment welcomes families with children of all ages

facts.text: At Camp Coyote, trained counselors lead kids in activities like nature walks and painting.
facts.excerpt: Kids can attend Camp Coyote, where trained counselors will lead attendees in activities like nature walks and painting

facts.text: The Artist Cottage offers creative activities like watercolors and pottery paired with a glass of wine.
facts.excerpt: The Artist Cottage is not to be skipped either, where creative activities like watercolors and pottery come paired with a glass of wine.

facts.text: Staying at Enchantment includes access to the private Seven Canyons golf course.
facts.excerpt: Staying at Enchantment also means access to the private Seven Canyons golf course

facts.text: The property's layout can make it hard to find your way around, especially at night.

facts.excerpt: Staff are more than happy to provide battery-powered golf cart rides around the resort and even over to Mii Amo for reservations.
